assets.name: AI Video Analytics & Crowd Prediction System
assets.owner: Head of Physical Security / Data Science

risks.treatment_action: DDoS filtering, rate limiting and scalable hosting
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Fake/replayed QR tickets allow unauthorized entry
risks.vulnerability: Weak QR validation, offline gaps or poor anti-replay checks.
risks.treatment_action: Signed QR tickets, online validation and anti-replay checks
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.vulnerability: Outdated terminals, weak segmentation or excessive vendor access.
risks.treatment_action: POS segmentation, patching, endpoint protection and restricted vendor access
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Public/guest network access reaches internal systems
risks.vulnerability: Weak separation between public, staff and operational networks.
risks.treatment_action: Separate guest, staff and OT networks with firewall rules and NAC
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Unauthorized access to live or recorded video
risks.vulnerability: Default credentials, weak MFA, exposed management interface or outdated firmware.
risks.treatment_action: MFA, unique accounts, firmware updates and isolated management access
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Attacker changes HVAC/lighting controls during an event
risks.vulnerability: Legacy protocols, remote maintenance access or weak isolation.
risks.treatment_action: OT segmentation, MFA for remote maintenance and allow-listed access
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: False crowd or facility sensor data is accepted
risks.vulnerability: Weak device authentication, insecure firmware or unencrypted traffic.
risks.treatment_action: Device authentication, encrypted traffic and firmware control
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.vulnerability: Shared admin accounts, exposed control panel or weak change control.
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Misconfiguration exposes stored data or services
risks.vulnerability: Misconfigured storage, excessive permissions or leaked API keys.
risks.treatment_action: Least privilege, configuration reviews and secure key handling
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.vulnerability: Weak MFA, password reuse, phishing or excessive privileges.
risks.treatment_action: MFA, separate admin accounts, PAM and regular access review
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.vulnerability: Unpatched systems, phishing exposure and broad internal access.
risks.treatment_action: EDR, patching, email security, segmentation and tested immutable backups
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.vulnerability: Application flaws, poor access control or insecure exports.
risks.treatment_action: Database access control, encryption, API security and monitoring
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Vendor compromise creates a path into stadium systems
risks.vulnerability: Over-privileged vendor accounts or weak supplier security checks.
risks.treatment_action: Security clauses, vendor review, limited access, logging and cyber insurance where suitable
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Backups are encrypted/deleted with production systems
risks.vulnerability: Backups reachable from production accounts or no immutable copy.
risks.treatment_action: Immutable/offline backup copies, separate credentials and restore testing
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: Important attack activity is not logged or alerted
risks.vulnerability: Missing logs, poor time sync, weak alert coverage or storage exhaustion.
risks.treatment_action: Central logging, alert testing, time synchronization and storage monitoring
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5

risks.event: AI crowd-prediction model gives wrong guidance from manipulated or drifted input
risks.vulnerability: Spoofed video, lack of drift monitoring or over-trust in crowd-risk output.
risks.treatment_action: AI inventory, input validation, drift monitoring and human review of safety-related output
risks.source: A1 PDF pp. 6–11; A2 PDF pp. 3–5
